narr: During the evening of May 28th, severe thunderstorms developed within Northwestern Kansas. These thunderstorms produced hail up to golf balls in size as well as torrential rainfall that resulted in flash flooding. Local law enforcement had to perform one water rescue due to the flood conditions.
ev: Flash flooding reported 4 miles east of Reager, KS on Highway 383. Local dispatch reported that there was one water rescue performed due to the flood conditions at the location.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 4 E REAGER. FLOODING REPORTED ON HIGHWAY 383. DISPATCH ALSO DID RELAY THAT THERE WAS ONE WATER RESCUE AND THAT WATER IS STILL HIGH IN THE AREA.
